input.sha256_scope: SHA-256 of the whole capture document, which is the reviewed unit here.
input.provenance: Self-authored boxes and lcg-v1 probability maps from tools/capture_unclip_score_oracle.py.

expected.sha256_scope: SHA-256 of the whole capture document; the score values are read from it by the consuming test.

limitations: Both halves are consumed by Rust. The unclip comparison normalises both sides by removing duplicate and collinear vertices and rotating to a canonical start, because this project deliberately does not implement Clipper's final union pass; src/unclip.rs records why that is unobservable in the M2 pipeline.
The score is exact to 1e-9 for the eight recorded boxes in the recorded scalar OpenCV 5.0.0 environment, and nothing else.
It does not establish detector output, model behaviour, or OCR compatibility.
